description: MerLin adaptation of accuracy_original (claim accuracy-parity): the photonic counterpart of QuClassi's 5-qubit circuit (2 photons in 4 modes, dual-rail data states, trainable 12-phase mesh, fidelity by inversion, exact FOCK probabilities), trained with DQuLearn's Algorithm 1 as written (simultaneous update, two-point shift pi/2, weights in [0, pi]) through the co-Manager on 2 workers, 25 epochs. Learning rate chosen on the validation split (sweep --lr). Sweep --pair and --seed.
